name: TinyFish

env_keys.comment: API keys and configuration variables documented by the provider.

python_extra.comment: HTTP API only; no required vendor Python SDK.

requires_key.comment: Valid API key required for every request.

snippet.comment: Every result exposes `snippet` with title, URL, site name and date fields.

country.comment: `location` takes a two-letter country code and defaults to US.

language.comment: `language` takes a language code and defaults to en.

date.comment: `after_date` / `before_date` (YYYY-MM-DD) or `recency_minutes`; not combinable with research-paper mode.

news.comment: `domain_type=news` returns news results with publisher and date fields.

mode.comment: One Search endpoint with no named fast/balanced/deep tier. Result count is fixed per page and controlled by `domain_type`, dates and pagination.

pricing_per_1k.value: Search $0.00 per request; free up to 12,000 requests/day at 30 req/min, then a positive wallet balance is required
pricing_per_1k.comment: Units and commitments differ; do not rank these as equivalent flat per-query prices.

primary_price.basis: Documented price is $0.00 per request; there is no paid per-1K search rate to rank

lowest_price.basis: $0 inside the 12,000 requests/day free allowance, so it stays unranked instead of sorting first

free_tier_limits.value: Search free within 30 requests/min and 12,000 requests/day (resets 00:00 UTC); Fetch free to 1,000 URLs/day; no card required
free_tier_limits.comment: Trial, monthly credits and model-tool promotions are distinct.

p50_latency.value: Historical July 2026: No published p50/p90/p95 API latency
p50_latency.comment: Historical evidence retained from July 2026; not remeasured or claimed current. TinyFish publishes rate and billing limits, not response-time percentiles.

notes: Search API (`GET https://api.search.tinyfish.ai`) is in both SDKs. The endpoint has no result-count parameter, so results are trimmed to `max_results` client-side; page bodies come from the separate Fetch API.

native_api.value: GET https://api.search.tinyfish.ai returns ranked web, news or research-paper results with title, snippet, URL, site name and news date. Supports include/exclude domains, location, language, recency and date bounds, an optional purpose hint, and pages 0-10. Separate Fetch, Agent, Research and Browser products share the same key.

rate_limits.value: 30 requests/min per API key by default (500 requests/hour on the pricing page); 12,000 free searches/day; HTTP 402 above the allowance when the wallet balance is zero

checked_at.comment: Official public documentation reviewed; no paid API or benchmark run.

capability_basis.comment: SDK availability is separate from native provider capability. Each native feature cell carries its own checked date and evidence.

sdk_support.comment: SDK adapter availability only. See Capability basis for the feature rows; native features do not imply an SDK adapter.
